categories.title: Body-Controlled Games
categories.blurb: Your body is the controller. A pose model tracks 17 keypoints from your webcam and turns them into play.

categories.title: Object Detection
categories.blurb: Point your camera at the world and see what a detector finds, box by box.

categories.title: Segmentation
categories.blurb: Pixel-accurate masks: cut things out, swap backgrounds, play with outlines.

categories.title: Vision Agents
categories.blurb: Models that look, reason and act, chained into small interactive tools.

experiences.title: Snack Attack
experiences.summary: Your palm is a hungry raccoon. Swipe through flying snacks and dodge the trash bags.

experiences.title: Flappy Raccoon
experiences.summary: Flap your arms like wings to keep the raccoon in the air and through the pipes.

experiences.title: Raccoon Dance
experiences.summary: Copy the coach like a mirror and get scored on every beat. Two original songs, on EASY, NORMAL or HARD.

experiences.title: Object Finder
experiences.summary: Live bounding boxes on whatever your camera sees, with labels and confidence.

experiences.title: Scavenger Hunt
experiences.summary: A list of everyday things to find and show to the camera before the timer runs out.

experiences.title: Cutout Studio
experiences.summary: Lift yourself or an object out of the frame and drop it onto a new scene.

experiences.title: Scene Narrator
experiences.summary: Detections become a running description of what is happening in front of the camera.
